items.title: 53571_Mary Lou Williams oral history interview
items.q: Levy, the owner, one of the brothers of Birdland got killed

ctx.x: that they chained her down like that in a house. Well, they did. People took her house from her and just had her in a bed and she wasn't being fed and a lot of things. Levy, the owner, one of the brothers of Birdland got killed and I called Father Woods and I said to him, "There's a man here from Birdland - " - I used to call him Father - the silliest thing - that's what he and Lorraine used to laugh about over the phone - and I picked up the News, somebody came to the house or something and brought the News in…

There was another guy, a newspaper man. I can't remember his name, with King Features. He was a very good friend of mine. He used to come and take me out and Peter (ran up?) Rabbit - well, this hasn't been too long ago and he was telling me about his death or something. I said, "He was
